g.text: Issues per day: opened (by who) and resolved
Resolved = issues closed as completed (not "not planned"); opened "by agents" = an agent marker in the issue body.
Change failure = merged PRs titled Revert or regression, over all merged PRs (a title heuristic).
First-pass rate, cost (Claude spend + runner hours), owner calls and the evidence ladder come from the factory's own numbers (factory.json, published by churn).
